changelog:
- Initial release of customer-support-memory skill (v1.0.0)
- Provides persistent vector memory for customer support agents using BlueColumn
- Enables storing, recalling, and searching full customer support context via API
- Requires BlueColumn API key; setup instructions provided
- Includes example curl commands for storing notes, quick notes, and recalling context
- Designed to prevent agents from re-asking questions and ensures personalized, context-rich support
summary: Give AI agents Customer support that never re-asks. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent handles support tickets and needs full context; when the user wants to store, recall, or search customer support memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
